annotations.title: Hand-picked cloud and DevOps roles from a past Jobs Brief edition

description: A hand-picked selection, a few dozen roles, not an exhaustive job search: senior cloud, platform, DevOps, SRE and AI-infrastructure roles from a past Jobs Brief edition, each read by an editor and kept only if it can be taken remotely from anywhere in the EU ('remote-eu') or from Poland ('poland'), at mid, senior or manager level. Each role has its location, contract form where stated, core stack, a one-line summary of the work, the published salary when there is one, and a link to the company's own posting. All filters are optional and combine.

level.description: mid: evidenced mid-level IC roles. senior: senior, staff and principal IC roles. manager: engineering managers and heads of engineering.

query.description: Free text matched against title, company and summary, e.g. 'observability' or 'GPU'.

section.description: remote-eu: remote roles open across the EU. poland: roles based in Poland.

stack.description: A technology to match in the role's stack, e.g. kubernetes, terraform, aws, gcp.
